item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 30
item.description:
124 development commits

Animals & Wildlife

  • Renaming of horses and chickens now requires a tool cupboard nearby, preventing unauthorized renames.
  • Horse canter controls adjusted for smoother movement.
  • New seagull group spawn points added to deep‑sea monuments, creating dynamic flocks.

Harbor & Loot

  • Fixed Tier 2 harbors on custom maps to spawn crates correctly.

Player Movement

  • Turn‑in‑place now respects parent yaw, eliminating odd rotation behavior.

Weapons & Crafting

  • Weapon addon points introduced, allowing new attachment options.
  • Quick‑craft UI now focusable and navigable with the D‑pad for console players.

World & Terrain

  • Erosion system improved with bug fixes and per‑biome splat maps for more consistent terrain changes.

Store & UI

  • Store “NEW” notifications now correctly show new skins, and a NullReferenceException crash in the store grid has been resolved.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Streamer mode now correctly hides animal names in all relevant menus.

Economy

  • Crude oil pumped from sphere tanks now counts toward your oil production total.

World Generation

  • World generation no longer places floating powerlines over caves; powerlines stay grounded.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Oct 29
item.description:
64 development commits

Base Building & Visibility

  • Fixed full‑height walls that could incorrectly connect to neighboring walls, preventing unexpected wall merges.
  • Implemented a voxel‑based flood fill to provide reliable base visibility, now detecting missing sockets and incorrect block connections.

Weapon & Gear Adjustments

  • Research and crafting for the UZI 9mm have been disabled, and a sight‑mod bug that overwrote ADS values when the stock collapsed has been fixed.

UI & Audio Fixes

  • Loadouts UI delete popup is interactive again.
  • Night‑vision goggle sound no longer restarts when gesturing.
  • Mortar ammo indicator now updates correctly when ammo changes.
  • Job feedback UI now shows correct messages during job execution.

World & Structures

  • Monuments are no longer placed where terrain blend maps overlap river topology, eliminating floating water on monuments.
  • Beacon repairable objects no longer block ladders, allowing uninterrupted climbing.
